title: The very curious bird
summary: A story about Mina, a book and a new discovery.
outcome: Find key details and put story events in order.

activities.prompt: Mina finds a book under a tree. She opens it and sees a bright blue sea. “Come and look!” she calls to her friends. They sit together and read about a curious bird.
What does Mina find?
activities.passage: Mina finds a book under a tree.
activities.explanation: The first sentence tells us that Mina finds a book.

activities.prompt: Put the story in order.

title: A morning in the garden
summary: Listen closely for sounds, people and places.
outcome: Recall details from a short spoken passage.

activities.prompt: Listen to this garden story. Sam opens the garden gate. He hears two birds singing in a tree. His sister waters the red flowers. They sit on a bench and listen to the breeze.
What does Sam hear in the tree?
activities.explanation: Two birds are singing in the tree.

activities.prompt: Choose the two things from the story.
activities.explanation: The garden has red flowers and a bench.

title: Hello, new friend!
summary: Practise clear greetings and a short introduction.
outcome: Speak clearly and take turns in a simple conversation.

activities.prompt: Listen to the conversation and practise each turn.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Hello, Mina. I am Sam. What do you like to read?

activities.prompt: Say this greeting in a clear, friendly voice: Hello! It is nice to meet you.
Introduce yourself using a pretend name. Tell us one thing you like. You can listen to and record another try.

title: Build a little adventure
summary: Choose words, spellings and correctly formed sentences. No typing.
outcome: Select correct words, spellings and sentences from given options.

activities.prompt: Choose the sentence with the words in the correct order.
activities.explanation: We found a map. puts the subject before the verb and ends with a full stop.

activities.prompt: Choose the word to complete: Yesterday we ___ a map.
activities.explanation: The past form of find is found.

activities.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct capital letter and full stop.
activities.explanation: Start with a capital W and finish with a full stop.

activities.prompt: Choose the correct spelling of the word made from m - a - p.
activities.explanation: The letters m, a and p spell map.

activities.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
activities.explanation: Use has with she in the present tense.

activities.prompt: Choose the word that means below: The map was ___ the tree.

title: Sentence builders
summary: Choose verbs, fill a gap and repair a sentence.
outcome: Use simple present verbs that agree with the subject.

activities.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct verb.
activities.explanation: Use walks with she in the simple present.

title: Words for curious minds
summary: Discover new words and connect them to meanings.
outcome: Recognise and use vocabulary from familiar stories.

activities.prompt: Explore these words. Listen to them and read the examples.

entries.definition: Wanting to learn or know more.
entries.example: The curious bird looked inside the book.
We discover a path in the garden.
A cool breeze moves the leaves.

activities.prompt: Match each word to its meaning.
Spell the word that means a gentle wind.
